title: Turkish Army Accepts Yılkı Gözükara Systems as MKE Delivers Fırtına Howitzers
excerpt: Türkiye's defence ministry says inspection and acceptance of Yılkı Gözükara systems for the Land Forces is complete and MKE has delivered Fırtına howitzer systems and spares.
